notes.title: Viviette is available NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you can see, our new game [b][i]Viviette[/i][/b] is available now! We hope you like this hand crafted exploration adventure, and also the horror side of the experience. We highly recommend avoiding any kind of spoilers before playing. Long long time ago we had this idea floating around our heads, and just this year we decided to make it a reality. And this is the result!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018137/f8c01d882ac3b853c17600acdbd02369af08e220.jpg[/img]

As we have mentioned before, this is a [b]classic horror[/b] game where you'll have to [b]explore[/b] and solve some [b]puzzles[/b]. In adversity, you should persevere. We really encourage solving everything by yourselves. But if you need any help, we're sure other players will assist you in the game's [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/]discussion forums[/url].

That's all we have to say, to be honest. Just enjoy the experience!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Viviette Release Date: 18 October 2018
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our upcoming new game, [b]Viviette[/b], now has an official release date:

[h1]18 October 2018[/h1]

Well, that's next week, on Thursday!

Viviette is an [b]exploration-puzzle[/b] game with touches of [b]classic horror[/b]. We highly recommend avoiding any kind of spoliers before playing the game, so that you can enjoy the full experience your own way. We think the game is super immersive from start to end.

In adversity, you should persevere. But if you get stuck in the game, just ask for help in the project's [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/]discussions forum[/url]. We won't reply, but surely other players will do. We will only reply to bug reports or technical issues, though we think the game is bug free.

Meanwhile, adding it to your [b]wishlist[/b] will help with visibility before launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/883070/Viviette/

Thanks for reading!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: v3.1.0 - Multi-Language!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9148364/0ebd5ecf3ac0fde84ca8739f7611ead506e8b6e5.png[/img]

SSP is now [b]multi-language[/b], supporting the languages you see in the picture above. For new players, the language should be selected automatically the first time you run the game. Anyway, to change the language go to:

[b]OPTIONS > LANGUAGE[/b]

We have also fixed a music loop bug in the audio engine and improved the [b]gamepad detection system[/b], among other things.

Thanks for supporting this little game!

notes.title: Update v3.0 - Lots of fixes!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9148364/3d5af5572d2286ccb9276082b18bf1cf1fc6278e.gif[/img]

Finally!

After so long, we have been able to recover [b]Super Star Path[/b] base code, so we have fixed / improved a lot of stuff! For the moment, these changes are only available for [b]Windows[/b]. We will update Mac and Linux builds probably next month.

[h1]Changes in v3.0[/h1]

- [b]New game engine.[/b] The game code now matches our current game engine, so maintaining this project won't be a pain anymore.

- The game now uses [b]DirectX 11[/b], and we have also improved overall [b]performance[/b].

- [b]New options UI.[/b] We have implemented a more functional options menu, and now you can [b]customize keyboard and gamepad controls[/b]. Also, menu navigation is more intuitive.

- [b]Difficulty modes.[/b] Now you can select the difficulty level that better suits your needs. Three modes available: Easy, Normal and Hard.

- [b]Improved procedural level generator.[/b] You should always find a path... if you choose the right path, obviously! It's a puzzle game after all, so you need to know the rules and select your next target carefully!

- [b]Higher quality sound[/b]. We have increased the bitrate at which music and sound is encoded, with no much impact on download size.

- [b]Removed the on-screen radio text message[/b]. The pilot still talks (you can disable this), but the text message won't bother you anymore during boss fights.

- Some [b]visual improvements[/b] on sprite animation, smooth parallax scroll, etc.

- Many bug fixes and adjustments.

[h1]Support[/h1]

If you have any [b]issue[/b] with this new version, let us know in the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/375120/discussions/]forums[/url].

Thanks for supporting this little game!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: v2.4 - Auto-fire for all!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have just uploaded a new build of the game (v2.4) for all platforms (Windows, Mac and Linux).

We have added [b]auto-fire during boss battle[/b] for all spaceships, because it's a feature that has been requested many times by some players. The ship that had auto-fire as main ability has been modified: now it can [b]double shoot bouncing projectiles in diagonal direction[/b] during boss battles. It may be useful.

Thanks for playing!

Alberto & Dani

notes.title: Improved performance and current game status.
notes.content:
Hello!

We have just uploaded a new SSP update, featuring [b]performance improvements[/b]. Now the game should run much better on any computer, though it will be more noticeable on old ones (smoother scrolling and animation, etc).

[b]Steam Cloud[/b] is working as expected. You can retrieve your saved data from any computer and OS. Play on Windows, continue on Mac, etc. Quite handy.

The [b]sound bug on Linux[/b] is still there, we can't fix it right now. Remember that it only happens when playing on-line. If you browse the game local folder and launch it from there, it will work (though it won't sync leaderboards, achievements, etc). Even if we don't have many sales on Linux, we would like to offer a good working build. We will post a new announcement if we find a solution.

It's just that! Thanks for playing!

Alberto & Dani

notes.title: Steam Cloud support and Windows 10 issues explained.
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Some players reported Windows 10 issues (game crashes at start). After investigating during some days, we discovered that the way the game is storing game data is not working on Windows 10, so we have changed that. And now, because of the new game data storing system allowing it, we have also added [b]Steam Cloud[/b] support. No more data loss.

What does this mean for you?

Unfortunately, players that have already moved from Windows 7/8 to Windows 10 will lose the old game saved data. There is no solution to this. At least, you can run the game again.

Players that are still using Windows 7/8 will preserve saved data if they download the update and run the game once. Then, you can safely move to Windows 10 if that's your desire.

Sorry a lot for the inconveniences. We hope you can understand that, when a new operative system appears, these issues may happen. We have worked on this as fast as we could.

Alberto & Dani

notes.title: Fixed Soundtrack DLC and other issues
notes.content:
Hello!

First, thanks to all our players for purchasing and playing this humble indie game. We hope you like it (the gameplay, graphics, sfx, music, voice acting, etc.).

Since the game's release, and from the shadows, we have been fixing many little bugs like, for example, sound issues. Also, we have added [b]gamepad controller support for Mac[/b]. There is still a sound bug in Linux that happens if you play on-line. If you play off-line, everything works as expected. We can't fix this issue at the moment.

And just today, we have fixed the [b]Soundtrack DLC[/b], so now you can add it for free to your Steam music library.

It's just that, have a nice day!

Alberto & Dani
